tickets.title: Screen debt refinance opportunity
tickets.text: Compare current loan terms with proposed terms, including rate, remaining term, closing costs, cash-flow impact, break-even period, and planning risks before recommending next steps. For Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk, review the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs.
tickets.evidence: Liora asked for a side-by-side review of the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-03.

tickets.title: Analyze mortgage reset timing and refinance lock decision
tickets.text: Review the mortgage servicer’s notice and the upcoming rate change window to recommend timing for locking a refinance quote or remaining with the current lender.
tickets.evidence: the household wants a recommendation early enough to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-30.

tickets.title: Reconcile escrow and household budget property tax and insurance amounts
tickets.text: Reconcile the different monthly property tax and insurance amounts in the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora Nettlewhisk’s household budget to resolve the uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset.
tickets.evidence: the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, creating uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-27.

tickets.title: Follow up on Teacup Comet Bank HELOC autopay issue and reserve protection
tickets.text: Follow up on the Teacup Comet Bank HELOC autopay being drafted twice in one cycle, which reduced the checking account cushion and forced a transfer from savings before payroll posted. Address the duplicate draft and the temporary reserve impact.
tickets.evidence: Liora reported that Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-21.

tickets.title: Review debt repayment funding and tax lot concentration risk
tickets.text: Review funding the credit card balance and part of the auto loan with Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares, considering the tax lots’ varying holding periods and unrealized gains. Assess how selling shares could reduce concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: a portfolio review showed that selling enough Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to pay off the credit card balance and part of the auto loan could reduce concentration risk, but the tax lots vary significantly by holding period and unrealized gain; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-10.
